config.primary_unchanged_rules: Per-city calibration on first30days; one selected order per city-day from signal information only; actual distinct outcome ask and depth at delayed execution; no fill-based reranking
config.historical_tick_policy: Ask markup is an adverse cost buffer, not a literal tick-valid limit order; missing initial tick/minimum metadata disclosed
config.limitations: Seven calendar days; conditional displayed depth, not live fills; provider comparisons exploratory; no profitability certification
